articles.title: Watch: The life of an iconic country singer
articles.description: Iconic country musician Dolly Parton has died at the age of 80, the singer's team announced on social media.

articles.title: Household energy bills to hit three-year high as Ofgem announces 4% rise from October
articles.description: A household using a typical amount of gas and electricity will pay £60 a year more, regulator Ofgem says.

articles.title: Dad of woman who took her own life says Treasury failed in its duty of care
articles.description: Chloe Moffat died last year, after she was told of allegations she had shared sensitive confidential information about colleagues, which she denied.

articles.title: Yellow warnings remain in force as rain and thunderstorms hit parts of UK
articles.description: Yellow warnings updated as torrential downpours affect parts of England and Wales, delivering some of the wettest weather in several weeks.
